title: NAFAU/Shoprite and AR public actions at Walvis Bay Dunes Mall and other reported towns
notes: Informanté reports the Shoprite/NAFAU action planned for 14 January continued Friday and Saturday at the Dunes Mall, with police intervention also reported in Keetmanshoop and Tsumeb. Workers asked AR to help close shops; AR members sought access to deliver food and water, while the private mall blocked entry. No demand to the Namibian state or local crowd count is reported. Police intervention and rubber-bullet use do not transform a private-employer/private-property grievance into a state-directed demand. These January phases remain associated with the December-started Shoprite continuation; dates and attendance by specific location need follow-up.

title: Tsumeb Shoprite actions during the NAFAU strike (date and episode unclear)
notes: The 20 January Republikein issue search snippet says Tsumeb Shoprite workers protested the previous Wednesday. The 15 January Namibian Sun search result reports community members joined striking workers and closed the branch on a Tuesday morning. The weekday references may describe separate actions/phases or differ in reporting; keep the event date null and do not merge them as a single verified gathering. Neither source gives a local attendance count or a demand to the Namibian state. The Shoprite wage dispute targeted the private employer; police presence does not create a state-policy demand. Do not infer local turnout from nationwide workforce or strike figures. The sources are search-only and exact occurrence needs follow-up.
